items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Lewis left us to go with Fletcher Hennessy in 24... I was in band with Louis... Lewis read Fletcher, he made the band... Lewis was a great musician.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was Tommy and King. See, Lewis left us to go with Fletcher Hennessy in 24. Tommy took his place. Then he went with this man, or I forgot, Sam Wooden. And then after he left, then Bob Shaffler came with me. And he stayed with the man until I left.
Did you work with Louis at the same time with King Arthur? Yes. You were there. Yes, yes. I was in band with Louis. That's it. Did you make many tours? Yes, we toured in Pennsylvania.
